ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the fluke surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels (black) with high-intensity pixels (white) restricted to small, isolated clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly solid dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface; high-contrast white geometric clusters are confined to the lateral terminal coordinates of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, consistent serration; right lobe trailing edge displays irregular, higher-amplitude serrations including a prominent jagged notch approximately two-thirds of the distance from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer margins of both lobes, tapering into acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixels (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, distinct circular lesion or attachment site with a small trailing light-colored appendage is visible in the medial-inferior region of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe trailing edge features a unique, deep irregular indentation (notch) that distinguishes it from the smoother profile of the left lobe.
